message.reasoning: We need to list guidance. No missing fields. No conflicts. Provide preparation steps: ensure HFE still valid, update income if changed, ensure documents ready. Also caveat to check HDB portal.

parsed.summary: Before proceeding to Step 2, ensure your HFE is still valid, confirm no changes to your personal or financial details, and gather all required documents.

claims.text: The HFE (Housing Flat Eligibility) letter is valid for 12 months from the issue date, provided there are no material changes to your household profile.
Verify that your HFE issued on 25 October 2026 is still within its 12‑month validity period before you submit Step 2 on 15 November 2026.
Check that neither of you has acquired any private property, received any other HDB flat or subsidy, or experienced a change in citizenship status since the HFE was issued.
If any of the above circumstances have changed, you must inform HDB and may need to re‑apply for a new HFE before proceeding to Step 2.
Gather the required supporting documents for Step 2, such as NRIC copies, marriage certificate, latest payslips, and CPF statements.
Ensure your latest income information is up to date; if your monthly income has changed since Step 1, be prepared to declare the new figure in Step 2.
Policy details may be updated; always confirm the latest Step‑2 requirements on the official HDB website (hdb.gov.sg) or the HDB Flat Portal.
